name: perchlight-list
description: A free, self-hosted mailing list for Cloudflare Workers + D1: double opt-in signups, spam blocking, and announcement emails.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

IP_SALT.description: Required. Any long random string, e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Hashes IP addresses for the signup rate limit.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional. Your Turnstile secret key (Cloudflare dashboard → Turnstile). Leave empty to turn the bot check off.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: **Resend only.** A sending-access API key. Leave empty for other services.

RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: **Resend only.** Your Resend webhook's signing secret (starts with `whsec_`).

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: **Amazon SES only.** An IAM user allowed `ses:SendEmail` and `ses:SendBulkEmail`.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: **Amazon SES only.** That IAM user's secret key.

SES_SNS_TOPIC_ARN.description: **Amazon SES only.** ARN of the SNS topic your bounce and complaint notifications go to.

MAILGUN_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY.description: **Mailgun only.** Settings → Webhooks → HTTP webhook signing key (not the API key).

POSTMARK_WEBHOOK_USER.description: **Postmark only.** A user name to put in your webhook URL.

POSTMARK_WEBHOOK_PASSWORD.description: **Postmark only.** A password to put in your webhook URL.
